AUDIT: Distinct consumption/attempt/actual-created-process/observation/failure records. Preauthority failures return exceptions for qualified controller audit; no unauthorized store writes. Process creation error is LAUNCH_FAILED, missing observation is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Inert callback is marked synthetic, not a historical probe event
CONCURRENCY: Nonblocking owner epoch lock covers validation/claim/launch, plus exclusive permanent identity-keyed file; no stale-lock cleanup
DURABILITY: Complete write loop; file fsync; directory fsync; separate readonly identity/byte/inode verifier before callback/launch
EXCLUSIVE_RESERVATION: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW using qualified store directory descriptor; duplicate identical record is never success
PRODUCTION_LIMITATION: Real entry explicitly disabled by QUALIFIED_REAL_AUTHORITY_BINDING=None. Gate-local normalized receipt schemas are prototypes; not mappings from actual issued H77 records. Qualified actual authority-reader/profile integration remains missing
RECOVERY: Readonly: consumed or unknown with launch_permitted=False and retry_allowed=False; absent record does not itself restore permission
RESERVATION_AMBIGUITY: Reservation observer marks potential consumption at atomic create, before write or barriers; errors never delete or recreate token
SOURCE_REVIEW_REPAIRS: Frozen canonical copy of caller entry before validation
Exact integer types for limits, attempt, epoch and retry policy
Reservation marker applied immediately after exclusive create
Bound parent launch CWD through profile without leaking host-directory descriptors into child
Static reviewer strengthened to inspect every launch/retry permission return after a mutation exposed a reviewer coverage gap
